verdict.rationale: Helicone documents some environment separation of its own. Prompt versions can be deployed independently to production, staging and development environments (helicone-docs-45). The Playground lets you test prompts, sessions and traces (helicone-gh-3). Docker Compose self-hosting is documented as suited to local development (helicone-docs-20). None of this explicitly describes an isolated sandbox whose logged requests and data are kept apart from production. missing for 10: a documented sandbox or test-mode environment, explicit isolation of test data from production logs and analytics, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
